The Breathwork Way · Birthday Retreat

Morocco
for Sandy's 60th

24 – 29 Sep · 2026 Marrakech + Essaouira 5 nights · 6 days

Scroll to explore

Six days between the medina and the Atlantic. Slow mornings, a private villa, breathwork, adventure, and space to celebrate life properly.

Day by day

The journey unfolds

Day 1 · 24 Sep

Marrakech

Arrival in the medina

You will be picked up at the airport and transferred directly to Riad Assouel et Spa, tucked into a quiet alley in the heart of the old medina. An evening out for dinner on a beautiful rooftop terrace, surrounded by the sounds and light of Marrakech at dusk.

Day 2 · 25 Sep

Marrakech → Essaouira

Breakfast, then west to the Atlantic

After breakfast at the riad, we board a private minibus and head west through the argan forest. The landscape shifts slowly from city to countryside to coast. We arrive at Villa Betty, 20 minutes outside Essaouira, by early afternoon. First swim in the pool, first look at the forest.

About 2.5 to 3 hours by private minibus

Days 3–4 · 26–27 Sep

Villa Betty, Essaouira

Villa days at the Atlantic

Two full days at the villa, shaped around what feels right. Morning movement or breathwork sessions by the pool. Meals sometimes eaten in the shade of the olive trees, sometimes out in Essaouira's blue-and-white medina. There will be a blend of planned moments and open time. Some things will be organised. Others will be completely yours to fill, or not fill, as Morocco asks of you.

Day 5 · 28 Sep

Essaouira → Marrakech

Return to the medina

A final morning at the villa before we drive back east through the argan forest. We arrive at Bliss Riad in the heart of Marrakech by late afternoon. An evening out for a farewell dinner together in the medina.

Day 6 · 29 Sep

Departure

Early morning, homeward

Your transfer to the airport is taken care of. Morocco stays with you.

Where you stay

Beautiful places, carefully chosen

Night 1 · 24 September · Marrakech Medina

Riad Assouel et Spa

A 17th-century riad in the heart of the medina, 200 metres from Ben Youssef Madrasa. Nine individually decorated rooms blending Moroccan tradition with a clean, contemporary feel. A courtyard pool, hammam, rooftop terrace with Jacuzzi, and an in-house chef. Quiet enough to sleep, close enough to everything.

Heart of the Medina Courtyard pool Hammam & spa Rooftop terrace Breakfast included

Nights 2–4 · 25–27 September · Essaouira Countryside

Villa Betty

A six-bedroom villa set in an argan and olive forest, 20km from Essaouira, entirely yours for three nights. A 12x5m infinity pool in Fez mosaic, a eucalyptus pergola terrace looking out over the trees, and a full household team including a cook who prepares meals from fresh market produce. The pool, the pergola, and the silence of the argan forest.

Full exclusive hire Infinity pool Cook included Argan forest 6 bedrooms Full household staff

Night 5 · 28 September · Marrakech Medina

Bliss Riad

Back in the medina for the final night, at Bliss Riad on Rue Mouassine. Nine rooms designed around the idea of arrival and exhale. A rooftop terrace with Atlas and Koutoubia views, hammam, yoga deck, and an in-house chef for the farewell dinner.

Rue Mouassine, Medina Rooftop with Atlas views Hammam Yoga deck In-house chef

Your host

Fabio

I work with breathwork and nervous system regulation, mostly with founders and C-level executives navigating high-pressure lives. My work sits at the intersection of performance, presence, and learning to actually feel what's happening inside.

I met Sandy last year in Portugal, and when she asked me to help shape something special for her 60th, I said yes without hesitation.

Originally from Italy, I have lived in many places across the world and now call Lisbon home. I organise retreats internationally and know Morocco well. I will be there with you from the first pickup to the last goodbye, taking care of everything so you can simply show up and enjoy.
